facts.claim: The Airbus A350-900ULR achieves a maximum operational range of 9,700 nautical miles (11,163 miles / 17,964 km).

Engineers gained an additional 24,000 liters of fuel capacity by modifying the internal architecture of the existing wing and center wing box, repurposing existing internal vent space and relocating fuel sensors, pushing total usable fuel capacity from roughly 141,000 liters to 165,000 liters without adding bolt-on auxiliary fuel tanks.

The aircraft's certified maximum takeoff weight was raised to 280 tonnes, and Singapore Airlines deactivates the forward cargo hold on these airframes, giving up 19 tonnes of belly freight payload capacity.
Singapore Airlines configures its A350-900ULR subfleet with only 161 seats, split between 67 business class seats and 94 premium economy seats, with no traditional economy class cabin.
The widebody platform achieved ETOPS-370 approval, which permits operation up to 370 minutes away from the nearest suitable airport.
In June 2026, the Airbus A350-1000ULR completed its inaugural flight, pushing range to 10,000 nautical miles (18,520 km) with a specialized rear center wing tank.

zh.title: A350-900ULR的9700海里航程不是靠外掛油箱換來的
zh.summary: A350-900ULR以改造既有機翼內部空間換取額外燃油，並以停用前貨艙與取消經濟艙換取重量餘裕，成就新加坡航空全球最長直飛航線的營運基礎。
body: A350-900ULR的最大營運航程達9700海里，但其關鍵並非加裝外掛副油箱。工程團隊改造既有機翼與中央翼盒內部結構，挪用原有通氣空間並重新配置燃油感測器，使可用燃油從約14.1萬公升增至16.5萬公升，額外增加2.4萬公升，且未改變機翼油箱外形。為承受滿油重量，認證最大起飛重量提高至280公噸，新加坡航空並停用這些飛機的前貨艙，放棄19公噸腹艙貨運酬載。
客艙同樣為航程讓路：標準構型可載300人以上，新加坡航空的A350-900ULR僅配置161席，包括67席商務艙與94席豪華經濟艙，完全取消傳統經濟艙，藉此省下座椅、旅客行李、餐車與飲用水等重量。該機型並取得ETOPS-370認證，可在距離最近合適機場370分鐘的範圍內營運；2026年6月，A350-1000ULR完成首飛，航程進一步推升至1萬海里，並改以專用後中央油箱承載越洋燃油。

en.title: The A350-900ULR's 9,700-nautical-mile range comes from subtraction, not extra tanks
en.summary: The A350-900ULR reaches 9,700 nautical miles not with bolt-on auxiliary tanks but by reworking the wing's internal space for 24,000 extra liters of fuel, deactivating the forward cargo hold and flying a 161-seat, no-economy cabin for Singapore Airlines' longest non-stop route.
body: The Airbus A350-900ULR achieves a maximum operational range of 9,700 nautical miles (11,163 miles / 17,964 km), and the engineering behind it rejected the traditional approach of installing heavy bolt-on auxiliary fuel tanks inside the lower cargo decks. Instead, engineers gained an additional 24,000 liters of fuel capacity by modifying the internal architecture of the existing wing and center wing box, repurposing existing internal vent space and relocating fuel sensors, pushing total usable fuel capacity from roughly 141,000 liters to 165,000 liters without changing the exterior skin of the wing tanks.

To carry that fuel weight, the certified maximum takeoff weight was raised to 280 tonnes, and Singapore Airlines deactivates the forward cargo hold on these specialized airframes, giving up 19 tonnes of belly freight payload capacity. The cabin follows the same logic: instead of more than 300 seats in a standard three-class layout, the subfleet carries only 161 seats, split between 67 business class seats and 94 premium economy seats, with no traditional economy cabin. The platform's ETOPS-370 approval permits operation up to 370 minutes away from the nearest suitable airport, and in June 2026 the larger A350-1000ULR completed its inaugural flight, reaching 10,000 nautical miles with a specialized rear center wing tank.
